title: Our
subtitle: HISTORY
intro: Discover how Snacks Yummies became the leading snack brand in Central America, from our humble beginnings to the present day.
about_section_paragraphs: Taqueritos was born from a passion for creating unforgettable moments. We are a brand that understands gamer culture and perfectly fuses it with the most intense and authentic flavors of Central America.
Our commitment goes beyond offering quality snacks. We create a community where gamers, food lovers and content creators find their space to shine, compete and share unique experiences.

With a presence in multiple countries in Central America and the Caribbean, we are dedicated to boosting local talent, organizing epic tournaments and developing products that adapt to the dynamic lifestyle of our community.
presence_section_description: With a strategic presence in 6 countries across Central America and the Caribbean, we bring the Taqueritos experience to millions of gamers and food lovers.
experiences_section_description: Explore everything Taqueritos has to offer: from epic competitions where you can show off your skills and win incredible prizes, to events and moments lived together with our community.

items.text: With an industrial chip cooker fryer with a capacity of 175 pounds of fried product and a banana slicer, Dinant produced its first plantain chips that were cut into slices like long, rectangular bars.
Yummies, which started operations with 10 employees, was founded in San Pedro Sula in 1976 with the goal of supplying the Honduran market with varied, high-quality snacks.

The production of salty snacks began with the making of Churritos, Corn Chips, Caramel Popcorn, and Burra's Milk Caramel under the Yummies brand, using partly rented machinery and fairly artisanal processes.

An icon is born. We launched Taqueritos, a snack that quickly won over thousands of palates. Since its arrival, it has become an iconic brand that unites generations and has placed Yummies' unique flavor at the top of the entire region.

Over these years, always under the Yummies brand, we have evolved in creating and consolidating leading brands like Ranchitas, Zambos, Ziba's, Taqueritos, Del Rancho, and Cappy, for which we have high-tech machinery and equipment, standardized processes, international certifications, and an extensive distribution network.

A new chapter begins. We renewed our image to reflect Yummies' evolution and our passion for innovation. New image, same passion for flavor. An identity that celebrates our history and looks to the future with energy and closeness, maintaining the same commitment to the quality that distinguishes us.

conclusion: Our history is a testament to innovation, quality, and commitment to our consumers. At Snacks Yummies, we continue working every day to bring the best products to your table, always maintaining the authentic flavor that characterizes us.
